documents.title: India Power Sector Presentation — ICICI Lombard
documents.description: Comprehensive overview of India's power sector for ICICI Lombard underwriting teams. Covers capacity, generation, key players, and risk landscape.

documents.title: India Power Sector Presentation — Generic Version
documents.description: Non-branded version of the power sector presentation suitable for external sharing and client meetings.

documents.title: BESS Deep Dive Report — Technology, Risks & Insurance
documents.description: Comprehensive report on Battery Energy Storage Systems covering chemistry, fire risks, thermal runaway, insurance framework, and India market outlook.

documents.title: Nuclear Power Risk Assessment — Insurable Perils
documents.description: Detailed analysis of insurable and non-insurable risks for India's nuclear fleet. Covers PHWR, VVER, FBR technologies. CLNDA liability framework explained.

documents.title: Transformer Availability Crisis — India RE Sector Impact
documents.description: Analysis of India's transformer manufacturing capacity shortage, its impact on renewable energy projects, and insurance implications (12-18 month lead times).

documents.title: Wind Farm Risk Survey Checklist — ICICI Lombard
documents.description: Standardised risk survey checklist for wind farm property insurance. Covers turbine condition, LPS, crane logistics, design class verification.

documents.title: Thermal Power Plant — Boiler Tube Failure Analysis
documents.description: Technical guide on boiler tube failure mechanisms (erosion, corrosion, overheating), prevention methods, and insurance claims data from Indian fleet.

documents.title: Solar Hailstorm Claims Guide — Rajasthan Corridor
documents.description: Post-event claims management guide for hailstorm damage at solar parks. Covers EL imaging, module replacement under BCD/ALMM, BI calculation methodology.

documents.title: Hydro Power — GLOF & Flood Risk Assessment Framework
documents.description: Framework for assessing glacial lake outburst flood (GLOF) risk at Himalayan hydro projects. Includes case studies: Chamoli 2021, Uttarakhand 2013.

documents.title: OEM Equipment Guide — BHEL Turbine Models & Claims Data
documents.description: Complete guide to BHEL turbine-generator models deployed in India (210MW to 800MW). Includes fleet data, known failure patterns, typical claims, and lead times.
